title: Aperiodic and simple-group wreath-division towers
abstract: Constructs a finite recursive wreath-division tower for every finite monoid in universe zero, with finite aperiodic or finite simple-group factors and every simple-group factor a monoid divisor of the original monoid. Implements a variant of the Diekert–Kufleitner–Steinberg local-divisor argument, with reusable monoid and semigroup division, local divisors, action coverings, wreath reassociation, and the Krasner–Kaloujnine group embedding. The endpoint permits arbitrary aperiodic factors and recursive intermediate bases; it does not assert the three-element flip-flop reduction, a single transformation-monoid strong division, or quantitative decomposition bounds.

informal.LeanPool.KrohnRhodes.krohn_rhodes_prime_: Every finite monoid M in universe zero admits a finite list of finite monoid factors, each witnessed to be aperiodic or a simple group, with DivTowerWreath M factors and every simple-group factor a monoid divisor of M. An empty tower means M divides the trivial monoid. At a nonempty step, M divides F wreath B for a finite action of a finite monoid B that itself has the tail tower.
informal.LeanPool.KrohnRhodes.krasnerKaloujnine_i: For any group G and normal subgroup N, the constructed monoid homomorphism from G to Mathlib's regular wreath product of N and G/N is injective. No finiteness assumption is required.
informal.LeanPool.KrohnRhodes.LocalDivisor.localD: For any monoid M and c in M, the local divisor on cM intersect Mc, with its twisted multiplication and identity c, is a quotient of a submonoid of M.
